## Google Play and App Store (Platform; G-cluster cloud apps)

- https://web.archive.org/web/20240813233441/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.sqex.game.ff9 -- the `android2` G-cluster row's page, FINAL FANTASY IX クラウド版 by ブロードメディア株式会社 G-cluster (package jp.co.sqex.game.ff9), 10K+ downloads, Android 6.0 or later, TV linkage supported, updated 2024-07-16; the page carries the service-end notice (sales stop noon 2024-08-30, service ends noon 2025-02-28) -- user, 2026-10-22; last capture, renders
- https://web.archive.org/web/20250114091548/https://gcluster.jp/pc/app/sqex/ff9/index_ios.html -- the `apple` G-cluster row's page, G-cluster's iOS game page (last capture; the first capture, https://web.archive.org/web/20170924015451/https://gcluster.jp/pc/app/sqex/ff9/index_ios.html, lists iOS) -- user, 2026-10-22
- https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1273920512 -- the App Store listing (capture 2020-01-06 shows Apple's splash; the page source holds the data): one app for iPhone, iPad, iPod touch (iOS 9.0 or later) and Apple TV; the Apple TV row's app, above -- accessed 2026-10-22
- Launch: the iOS app on 2017-09-19, per the phone app news page (https://web.archive.org/web/20250114083821/https://gcluster.jp/sp/app/sqex/news.html); the 2023-02-28 notice there says IX was also sold in KDDI's "au Game" service, which ended 2023-05-15, with buyers moved to the Google Play version
- The service ended 2025-02-28 noon, per the notice in sources/final-fantasy-franchise.md, so the rows are struck; Japan only; the Fire OS 5 or later line on G-cluster's app page has no matching Amazon listing found

- Releases (user, 2026-10-22): https://www.broadmedia.co.jp/news/2017/09/19-001571.html -- IX started 2017-09-19 on G-cluster, G-cluster for LEONET (Life Stick), Apple TV and Google Play; the App Store, the Amazon Android app store and Amazon Fire TV were announced as coming soon and are not confirmed for IX

## Hikari TV Games (Platform; Hikari TV cloud, set-top box)

- https://web.archive.org/web/20200706085019/http://game.hikaritv.net/title/ff9/index.html -- the `hikari-tv-games` row's link, the service's own game page; start 2017-12-19 (the service's news list) -- user, 2026-10-22; accessed 2026-10-22
  - Title "ファイナルファンタジーIX", copyright 2000, 2001 and 2016 (the 2016 Windows remaster); "the cloud version cannot rename characters"
  - Played with a game pad on a Hikari TV set-top box (NTT Plala, later Docomo), sold as a single title, not in the play-all pack; Japan only
  - The service ended 2023-09-30 23:59 (see sources/final-fantasy-franchise.md), so the row is struck; the row sits on the Remaster version, the same one as the G-cluster row
  - Phone or tablet use: the Android app (2013-11-20 to 2016-08-31, no iOS app) ended before IX started on Hikari TV (2017-12-19), so IX never ran on it; no phone row

## Cloud service launches (Platform; G-cluster)

- LEONET (Life Stick): from 2017-09-19, per the release above; its mirror, https://www.atpress.ne.jp/news/138097 (user-pasted 2026-10-23), adds the details
  - The Life Stick is pre-installed in the TVs of about 550,000 Leopalace21 rentals; "G-cluster for LEONET" is Leopalace21's resident internet service
  - Trial: 120 minutes on G-cluster and G-cluster for LEONET, 30 minutes on the app stores
  - TVs in the release's footnote (as of 2017-09): Sony BRAVIA and LG Smart TV models; Sharp AQUOS is not in it
- Broadmedia FY2017 Q2 deck (https://www.broadmedia.co.jp/ir/ir-library/presentations/dock/ir/171027_FY2017_2Q.pdf, 2017-10-27, user-pasted 2026-10-23): announces the FF IX cloud version, delivery from September; names no device; its partnership slide dates the LEONET Life Stick to June 2017
- Amazon.co.jp review of the G-cluster console set (ASIN B00CXJV6PE, https://web.archive.org/web/20190420223943/https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B00CXJV6PE, user-pasted 2026-10-22): 2018-01-12 says IX was played on a phone and the box then bought for the controller; it does not say which device ran the game, so corroboration only
- iOS app: 2017-09-19, per the phone app news page (https://web.archive.org/web/20250114083821/https://gcluster.jp/sp/app/sqex/news.html), whose notices of 2017-10 and 2017-11 call it the iOS version
- TV linkage page (https://web.archive.org/web/20170923211747/http://gcluster.jp/pc/app/sqex/connectTV.html): some Sharp AQUOS models do not support IX
- au Game (KDDI): sold there until 2023-05-15, then buyers moved to the Google Play version (the news page's notice of 2023-02-28)
